title: On almost periodicity in crystalline measures
summary: Meyer defined crystalline measures as tempered distributions $μ$ such that both $μ$ and its Fourier transform $\widehatμ$ are pure-point Radon measures of locally finite support. He conjectured that every crystalline measure is almost periodic as a tempered distribution. Favorov constructed a counterexample and asked whether crystalline measures are at least almost periodic as general distributions.
